title: SoundBridge hardware realtime validation result
description: Machine-readable output of tools/hardware-validation/sb-hw-validate. One file per command invocation. Two kinds share this schema: 'hw-run' (collect) and 'inventory' (inventory). Every optional property is optional because the value could not be measured, not because it is unimportant: absent is not zero. Where a required metric has no reader at all, the string 'not observable' is used and must be preserved verbatim by any consumer.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with fractional seconds and an explicit offset, e.g. 2026-11-23T15:09:42.645Z. Always UTC; the run's local timezone is reported separately in timezone.

notObservable.description: The single accepted spelling for 'no reader exists'. Never replace with 0, null, "unknown" or "n/a" in a required metric field.

runID.description: UUID generated per invocation; no meaning across runs.

timezone.description: IANA identifier of the machine's zone at run time.

deviceUID.description: kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceUID of the observed device. This, not the name, is the identity.

initialBucket.description: Format bucket the first window was cut against: '<rate>Hz/<frames>f'.

finalSnapshot.description: Empty object when the device was gone at the end of the run.

windowsRecorded.description: Windows actually written. Zero means nothing was observed; it does not mean the run was clean.

cpuLoadProcesses.description: H7 reversible load processes started by the harness (all killed on exit).

windows.description: One entry per observation window. Empty when no genuine IO was seen.

formatChanges.description: Union of harness-detected format changes and CoreAudio property-listener events, in the order they were recorded. A consumer must treat the two shapes as one timeline.

events.description: Host log lines the collector classified, plus the collector's own start/stop records.

detail.description: The log line verbatim, or a collector message. Never summarized or truncated.

operatorMarkers.description: Human timeline entries appended with `sb-hw-validate marker`. Empty means the operator recorded nothing, which is itself evidence.

criteria.description: Evaluation of the task's pass criteria. C1..C10 plus C-extra (p99.9).

status.description: 'MET (none reported)' is used only for audible symptoms when markers exist but none describes one. SKIPPED scenarios are represented by a marker containing the word 'skip', never by a status here.

enum: CONDITIONAL PASS — HARDWARE VALIDATION WITH DOCUMENTED LIMITATIONS

verdictReasons.description: Human-readable reasons, in the order they were detected. A non-empty list is required whenever verdict is not PASS.

p999FollowUp.description: Smallest safe production change that would make p99.9 observable. Documentation, not a promise.

quantiles.description: Provenance note for every pXXUs value in windows[].
examples: cumulative since AudioRenderer construction, not per window

windowCounters.description: Provenance note for callbacks / overBudget / overBudgetExcessMs / driverUnderrunDelta.
examples: callbacks / overBudget / excess / underrun are true per-window deltas

driverUnderruns.description: Which reader produced the underrun counters, or the literal 'not observable'.
examples: sb-shm-probe (read-only mmap of the live mapping)

mappingUID.description: The UID actually used to locate the shared mapping: the proxy device UID with the trailing '-soundbridge' removed, because the Host keys /tmp/soundbridge-<owner>-<uid> by the physical UID. Recorded so a reader can tell which path was probed.

logSources.description: Every process that wrote to subsystem com.soundbridge.host during the run, with a line count. Only SoundBridgeHost lines are treated as telemetry; the rest are counted here and dropped.

window.description: A window is always cut against one (rate, frames) pair. Two windows with different bucket strings have different deadlines and their overBudget values must never be added together.

ioRunning.description: kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsRunning OR ...IsRunningSomewhere at window end. Part of the genuine-IO proof.

callbacks.description: Callbacks observed in this window (delta of TimingSnapshot.observations).

overBudget.description: Deadline misses in this window, against this window's own deadline.

overBudgetExcessMs.description: Cumulative excess milliseconds over budget, differenced across the window.

maxSaturated.description: True when the reported max is the overflow floor (16.384 ms), i.e. the real max is at least that value.

quantilesAreCumulative.description: Machine-readable guard: p50Us/p95Us/p99Us/maxUs are cumulative since the Host started, not per-window values.

actualSampleRate.description: Stream physical rate when available, else nominal rate, read from CoreAudio.

deadlineMicroseconds.description: frames / sampleRate * 1e6, computed from this window's own snapshot.

p999Us.description: Always absent/null until a production change exposes it. Null is not zero.

observedCallbackRateHz.description: callbacks / elapsed seconds. Compared against expectedCallbackRateHz to prove real IO.

driverUnderrunDelta.description: Underruns in this window. Absent means not observable, never zero.

underrunSource.description: Which reader produced driverUnderrunDelta for this window.

isRunning.description: kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsRunning as seen by the observer process.

isRunningSomewhere.description: kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsRunningSomewhere: another process may hold the device.

bufferFrameSize.description: kAudioDevicePropertyBufferFrameSize — the ACTIVE size. Not the value in the range below.

defaultInput.description: Recorded for reference only; the hardware test never routes through it.
